raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) delivered txn_ts as epoch-millisecond strings such as '1768629721000' instead of ISO timestamps, so the unguarded CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. The epoch values fall around 06:00 UTC on 2026-01-17, matching the 06:00-ish intraday pattern of the other batches, so parsing all-digit values with epoch_ms (UTC) and keeping the ISO branch for other rows should restore correct timestamps and dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
